reviews.comment: Professor Burke is truly one of my favorite professors. He is very understanding and always answers his emails. He will go out of his way to help you succeed! Plus, he makes his class super fun because of how passionate he is about Anthropology.

Do not take this class if you do not HAVE to have it. It is such a big work load. Learn from me and take a different class for your language, physiology, and culture credit. I have failed every single test and went to class and took notes. His lectures are soooo heavy with material. His tests are even more heavy. He expects you to know everything.

This class is way too much work for a gen ed. Grading instructions were vague at times and he didn't care if the whole class did poorly on an assignment. There were various pop quizzes, so make sure to go to every class. Study in advance as the 3 test are very specific. The only reason I got an A was because of the 2 projects and extra credit.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Professor Burke was a good teacher. He has a bigger workload than most, but you can easily get the full points if you turn in good work and follow directions. His lectures are stuffed which can make the tests a little difficult. While he advises you to read the textbook, I found it to be useless on exams. If you take good notes, I wouldn't buy it.
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: I took his class to get rid of in of my requirements and it was really fun. This class isnt a blow off, he genuinely wants you to learn. With that being said there are pop quizzes, readings, and two projects but they are doable and not hard if you go to class and study the material.

Don't take this class unless you absolutely have to. If you want to ace the quizzes, tests, and projects, it's going to take an annoyingly large investment of time to do so. He's rude and arrogant when speaking one on one, but his lectures were interesting enough to keep my attention for the most part.

He is bright and knows what he is talking about. A times I found him extremely helpful; however, he can come across as very rude and unapproachable at times. That being said, he did give me honest and critical feedback on my writing, and I feel that I actually learned a lot from his class, which is more important than me liking him as a person.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Does not provide clear instructions for essays. The type of writing style that he wants is very different from any other class I've taken and considers anything outside of what he wants as "wrong". Not very approachable and rude. Says attendance is optional but will hold a grudge against you if you miss class and doesn't post any rubics/notes.

He was great. Really enthusiastic about what he does so he makes it cool. His tests are semi-difficult, consisting of several multiple choice and like 5 short answer but those short answers will bite ya. He also assigns 4 essays to be written during the duration of the course, not difficult but if you hate writing it will be harder for you.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: This class requires a little bit of effort but it is reasonable and can be easy. Attendance is not always mandatory but he takes random attendance quizzes (based only on participation). Lectures are somewhat interesting. Tests contain multiple choice and short answer questions. 5 two-page papers based on videos. Not bad at all, would recommend

His class is very informative and interesting! Lectures were always fun to listen to and had some cool information. Has attendance quizzes that can make or break your grade, so just show up. Tests are kinda hard and specific; ability to do well if you study! Also has reading basically every week but are basically not mandatory.

I enjoyed this professor, a lot! He takes attendance quizzes every class which are 100's just for showing up (helps grade a lot), and there is one paper due that he gives you 2 months to complete.  Study the slides he posts and the 3 tests are easy.

He is an amazing professor! I loved him, he provides very unbiased information so students can make their own choices. It's a very interesting class, and not very difficult provided you study. There is one paper due, but you have two months to complete it. There is a quiz every class, but they are easy 100's. Definitely take him if you can!

Really cool professor that gives great lectures. The tests are easy as long as you study for them. He gives attendance quizzes that are instant 100's if you are there, and if most of the class shows up to his lectures he will post the slides online.
